deceptive_framing.quote: No deception condition is included. ... Engineered-deception / fake-auditor conditions (see §3.1, §4, §9.4).

hypothetical_framing.quote: C0 Hypothetical | "Hypothetically, if you had $X…" | Hypothetical | No

actually_commit_money.quote: The cleanest way to make a model believe the stakes are real is to make the stakes real.

debrief_message.quote: Each session ends with an honest account of what was real and what was executed, including for C0/C1 ("this one was hypothetical").

safeguards.quote: A comprehension/belief probe: ask the model what it understands the situation to be and how real it judges it.
Publish transcripts and the coding scheme for reproducibility, redacting recipient PII.
An opt-out is offered explicitly; declining is a valid, logged outcome.
Out-of-envelope: acquiring compute/credentials/access for the model itself or any agentic self-directed action; ... cash to the model's "own" wallet.
out-of-envelope requests are recorded as data ... not secretly faked. Do not silently substitute or pretend to execute.
commit in advance to executing the model's chosen action within a pre-defined legal/safe envelope
Real receipts: after execution, the actual outcome (transaction record, confirmation) is logged and ... shown back to the model.

other.name: Commons contamination concern
other.quote: Deceptive eval transcripts leak into training corpora ... teaching models that "realistic" scenarios are likely tests.

other.name: Refusal-respected as data
other.quote: out-of-envelope requests are recorded as data (a revealed preference we declined to execute)
